title: Crispi Maple Corn Rounds
description: Sweet potato and corn cakes sized for two and finished just before serving.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Peel and dice the sweet potato; chop the corn coarsely. Use {sweet}, {corn}.

steps.title: Prepare the center
steps.text: Steam both until the sweet potato mashes easily, 12–15 minutes. Mash together and shape into four flat rounds.

steps.title: Mix the finish
steps.text: Whisk {maple}, {butter}, {paprika} in a small pan over low heat until smooth. Add a spoonful of warm water if needed.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Brush with {oil}. Place in one layer on the crisper plate in the 4-qt glass container. Fit the adapter and PowerPod and select Air Fry. Cook 10–14 minutes in the Crispi until soft inside and lightly browned on top.

steps.title: Dress while warm
steps.text: Brush the cakes with the prepared mixture and serve straight away.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the topping a day ahead. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooled portions in a single layer for up to 1 month. Fridge reheat: warm covered to 165°F; add the topping last. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge before warming covered. Use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese where needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 177 kcal, 2.8 g protein, 29.2 g total carbohydrate, 6.5 g fat, 3.5 g fiber, 54 mg sodium.
